privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Eyada, we are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect the information you provide when using our platform.
privacy.section1Content: Eyada is an intermediary digital platform designed to facilitate medical appointment booking between patients and doctors. Our role is limited to providing technical tools to simplify the booking and communication process. We do not provide any direct medical consultations or services.
privacy.section2Item1: Full name and contact information (email, phone number)
privacy.section2Item4: Family members' data added for booking purposes
privacy.section2Item6: Login credentials and platform activity data
privacy.section3Item1: Facilitating medical appointment booking and management
privacy.section3Item2: Communicating with you about your appointments and bookings
privacy.section3Item3: Improving service quality and user experience
privacy.section3Item4: Sending notifications related to your appointments
privacy.section3Item5: Responding to your inquiries and complaints
privacy.section4Content: We share your basic data (name and phone number) only with the doctor you book with, for the purpose of organizing your appointment. We do not sell or share your data with any third party for marketing purposes.
privacy.section5Content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction, including encrypting sensitive data and using secure connections.
privacy.section6Item1: Access your personal data stored with us

faq.q1: How do I book an appointment with a doctor on Eyada?
faq.a1: You can easily book an appointment by searching for the doctor or specialty you need, then selecting the clinic and suitable time slot and clicking the book button. You can book online 24/7.
faq.a2: Yes, the booking service on Eyada platform is completely free. You only pay the consultation fee to the doctor when visiting the clinic.
faq.q3: How do I track my appointment on Eyada?
faq.a3: You can track your appointment through the appointment tracking page using your booking number. You'll know your position in the waiting queue and the appointment status.
faq.q4: What medical specialties are available on Eyada?
faq.a4: Eyada offers all medical specialties such as internal medicine, pediatrics, ophthalmology, orthopedics, dentistry, dermatology, cardiology, obstetrics & gynecology, neurology, ENT, and many more.
faq.q5: Can I cancel or modify my appointment?
faq.a5: Yes, you can cancel or modify your appointment through your account on the platform. The cancellation policy varies according to each clinic's terms.
